product_updates.title: OpenAI is gaining on Anthropic with business users, new data indicates
product_updates.content: Businesses are willing to flop back and forth as each lab releases new models, volatility that should give both companies' investors pause about how "sticky" enterprise AI spending really is.

product_updates.title: ChatGPT can now send texts for you with new Apple Messages plug-in
product_updates.content: Ever wanted someone else to do your texting for you? ChatGPT is being offered up as an automated text scribe via a new Apple Messages integration.

product_updates.title: OK, can we actually cool data centers with our pee?
product_updates.content: Jason Kelce joked that people should cool data centers with their pee, rather than potable water -- but his suggestion is not completely ludicrous.

product_updates.title: Google gives publishers a new way to fight AI-driven traffic losses
product_updates.content: Google is giving publishers a new button that lets readers make them a preferred source across Search, Discover, and Google News, potentially boosting their traffic as AI search sends fewer clicks to the web.

product_updates.title: Runlayer, Rippling drop lawsuits — but the brouhaha is still a cautionary tale for founders
product_updates.content: Runlayer and Rippling have dropped their lawsuits. No money was paid. Rippling celebrated by releasing a competing product.

product_updates.title: Linkdaze’s smart calendar is built to run a household, not just track a schedule
product_updates.content: Linkdaze's smart digital calendar stands out for not putting its features behind a paywall, including an AI meal planner tool.

product_updates.title: Grok keeps sending gibberish responses to users
product_updates.content: Affected users told TechCrunch they were using Grok Lite, and noticed the issues as early as Wednesday morning.

product_updates.title: A third of web pages published since ChatGPT’s launch show signs of AI authorship, study finds
product_updates.content: ChatGPT and other AI models are now authoring and editing much of the new web.

product_updates.title: Ramp launches its own AI model router, called Router
product_updates.content: Ramp has launched its own AI model routing service, dubbed Router, that lets users and companies use and switch between various large language models via an API.

product_updates.title: Meta brings Pocket, an app that lets you vibe-code and share games, to US users
product_updates.content: Meta is bringing Pocket, its experimental AI-powered app for creating and sharing interactive games, to users across the U.S. after quietly testing it in Brazil.
